title: Plastic that bacteria make
subtitle: PHB, a plastic that nature can digest
subtitle_es: El PHB, un plástico que la naturaleza puede digerir
objective: Put three bacterial genes into E. coli so it turns sugar into PHB, a biodegradable plastic.
objective_es: Mete tres genes bacterianos en E. coli para que convierta azúcar en PHB, un plástico biodegradable.
description: The opposite of the plastic-eating level: here bacteria build plastic, and it can be broken down again.
description_es: Lo contrario del nivel come-plástico: aquí las bacterias fabrican plástico, y se puede volver a deshacer.

organism.scientificName_es: Escherichia coli + genes de Cupriavidus necator
organism.description: A laboratory bacterium carrying the three PHB genes of a soil bacterium.
organism.description_es: Una bacteria de laboratorio con los tres genes del PHB de una bacteria del suelo.

exploration.label: Problem
exploration.title: Plastic that never leaves
exploration.description: Most plastics come from petroleum and last for centuries. What if a plastic could be made from sugar and digested by microbes?
exploration.description_es: Casi todos los plásticos vienen del petróleo y duran siglos. ¿Y si un plástico se pudiera fabricar con azúcar y lo digirieran los microbios?

exploration.label: Source
exploration.title: A bacterium that stores plastic
exploration.description: Cupriavidus necator stores food as granules of PHB, the way we store fat. Up to 80% of its weight can be plastic.
exploration.description_es: Cupriavidus necator guarda alimento en gránulos de PHB, igual que nosotros guardamos grasa. Hasta un 80% de su peso puede ser plástico.

exploration.label: Pathway
exploration.title: Three genes, three steps
exploration.description: Two small molecules are joined, modified, and then linked into a long chain: the plastic.
exploration.description_es: Dos moléculas pequeñas se unen, se modifican y después se enlazan en una cadena larga: el plástico.

nodes.label: phaA gene
nodes.description: Recipe for the first enzyme, a thiolase.
nodes.description_es: Receta de la primera enzima, una tiolasa.

nodes.label: phaB gene
nodes.description: Recipe for the second enzyme, a reductase.
nodes.description_es: Receta de la segunda enzima, una reductasa.

nodes.label: phaC gene
nodes.description: Recipe for the plastic-building enzyme, PHB synthase.
nodes.description_es: Receta de la enzima que construye el plástico, la PHB sintasa.

nodes.label: Reductase (PhaB)
nodes.description: Turns acetoacetyl-CoA into the plastic's building block.
nodes.description_es: Convierte el acetoacetil-CoA en la pieza del plástico.

nodes.label: PHB synthase (PhaC)
nodes.description: Links thousands of building blocks into one long chain.
nodes.description_es: Enlaza miles de piezas en una cadena larga.

nodes.label: Building the chain
nodes.description: Thousands of 3-hydroxybutyryl units are linked one after another.
nodes.description_es: Miles de unidades de 3-hidroxibutirilo se enlazan una tras otra.

nodes.label: Acetyl-CoA
nodes.description: A basic building block every cell makes from sugar.
nodes.description_es: Una pieza básica que todas las células fabrican a partir del azúcar.

nodes.label: 3-Hydroxybutyryl-CoA
nodes.description: The building block of the plastic.

nodes.label: PHB plastic
nodes.description: Polyhydroxybutyrate: a hard plastic, similar to polypropylene, stored as granules inside the cell.
nodes.description_es: Polihidroxibutirato: un plástico duro, parecido al polipropileno, que se guarda en gránulos dentro de la célula.

nodes.label: Biodegradable plastic
nodes.description: Microbes in soil and water can digest PHB, so it does not pile up for centuries.
nodes.description_es: Los microbios del suelo y del agua pueden digerir el PHB, así que no se acumula durante siglos.

nodes.label: PET plastic
nodes.description: From the plastic-eating level. Made from petroleum, not by bacteria.
nodes.description_es: Del nivel come-plástico. Se fabrica a partir del petróleo, no con bacterias.

nodes.label: Glycogen
nodes.description: Another way cells store food, as chains of glucose. It is soft and dissolves: not a plastic.
nodes.description_es: Otra forma en que las células guardan alimento, como cadenas de glucosa. Es blando y se disuelve: no es un plástico.

invalidConnections.reason_es: El PET dura siglos en la naturaleza. Solo enzimas especiales, como las del nivel come-plástico, pueden deshacerlo.

steps.label: Feeding on sugar

steps.description_es: PhaC construye cadenas que se acumulan en gránulos.

hints.title: Big picture
hints.content: Three genes, three enzymes, three steps in a row. Each step uses what the previous one produced.
hints.content_es: Tres genes, tres enzimas, tres pasos seguidos. Cada paso usa lo que produjo el anterior.

hints.title: Guided solution
hints.content: Each gene to its enzyme. Thiolase–Joining; Joining–Acetyl-CoA and –Acetoacetyl-CoA. Reductase–Reduction; Reduction–Acetoacetyl-CoA and –3-Hydroxybutyryl-CoA. PHB synthase–Building the chain; Building the chain–3-Hydroxybutyryl-CoA and –PHB plastic. PHB plastic–Biodegradable plastic.
hints.content_es: Cada gen con su enzima. Tiolasa–Unir; Unir–Acetil-CoA y –Acetoacetil-CoA. Reductasa–Reducción; Reducción–Acetoacetil-CoA y –3-Hidroxibutiril-CoA. PHB sintasa–Construir la cadena; Construir la cadena–3-Hidroxibutiril-CoA y –Plástico PHB. Plástico PHB–Plástico biodegradable.

completion.title: Plastic from sugar
completion.summary: You moved a three-gene pathway from a soil bacterium into E. coli. The last enzyme does something new: instead of making a small molecule, it links thousands of them into a polymer.
completion.summary_es: Has trasladado una ruta de tres genes de una bacteria del suelo a E. coli. La última enzima hace algo nuevo: en vez de fabricar una molécula pequeña, enlaza miles de ellas en un polímero.
completion.realWorldImpact: PHB and related plastics (PHAs) are already used in packaging, cutlery and medical stitches that dissolve in the body. Their main challenge is cost: they are still more expensive than petroleum plastics.
completion.realWorldImpact_es: El PHB y plásticos parecidos (PHA) ya se usan en envases, cubiertos y puntos médicos que se disuelven en el cuerpo. Su principal reto es el precio: todavía son más caros que los plásticos del petróleo.

science.organism: Escherichia coli expressing the phaCAB operon of Cupriavidus necator
science.realWorldCase: In 1988 scientists cloned the PHB genes of the bacterium now called Cupriavidus necator and showed that E. coli could make the plastic with them. Today PHAs are produced industrially by fermentation.
science.realWorldCase_es: En 1988 se clonaron los genes del PHB de la bacteria que hoy se llama Cupriavidus necator y se demostró que E. coli podía fabricar el plástico con ellos. Hoy los PHA se producen industrialmente por fermentación.
science.scientificContext: β-ketothiolase (PhaA) condenses two acetyl-CoA into acetoacetyl-CoA, NADPH-dependent acetoacetyl-CoA reductase (PhaB) forms (R)-3-hydroxybutyryl-CoA, and PHA synthase (PhaC) polymerizes it into poly(3-hydroxybutyrate), stored as intracellular granules. Many soil and marine microbes secrete PHB depolymerases that degrade it.
science.scientificContext_es: La β-cetotiolasa (PhaA) condensa dos acetil-CoA en acetoacetil-CoA, la acetoacetil-CoA reductasa dependiente de NADPH (PhaB) forma (R)-3-hidroxibutiril-CoA, y la PHA sintasa (PhaC) lo polimeriza en poli(3-hidroxibutirato), que se guarda en gránulos dentro de la célula. Muchos microbios del suelo y del mar secretan PHB despolimerasas que lo degradan.
gameplaySimplifications: The reduction step also uses NADPH as a helper molecule.
Pure PHB is brittle; commercial products often mix it with other PHAs.
gameplaySimplifications_es: El paso de reducción también usa NADPH como molécula auxiliar.
El PHB puro es quebradizo; los productos comerciales suelen mezclarlo con otros PHA.
